usernameSetupHeaderDesc: Your @handle is your unique key on GupShupGo. Others can search and add you securely without sharing your phone or email.
usernameSetupTaken: @{handle} is already taken by another user.
usernameSetupTooShort: Username must be at least 3 characters long.
usernameSetupTooLong: Username must be at most 20 characters long.
usernameSetupInvalidChars: Only letters, numbers, and underscores allowed.
vaultSetupDesc: Choose a PIN to encrypt your message history. You will need it to read your messages on a new phone, so pick something you can remember.
vaultUnlockDescBio: Enter your PIN or tap fingerprint to decrypt history.
vaultUnlockDescPin: Enter your PIN to decrypt your history.
vaultReinstallHint: Enter your PIN to restore your history on this device. You can turn fingerprint unlock back on afterwards.
vaultPinMinLength: PIN must be at least 6 characters.
vaultFingerprintOutOfDate: Fingerprint unlock is out of date. Enter your PIN.
vaultBioReasonUnlock: Authenticate using biometrics to unlock your vault
vaultBioReasonEnrol: Confirm your fingerprint to enable quick unlock
vaultAskBioDesc: Skip typing your PIN on this phone. Your PIN is still what protects the vault — keep it somewhere safe, because you will need it on a new phone or after reinstalling.
vaultDeleteMessagesDesc:
Without your PIN your history cannot be decrypted, so resetting deletes all of it — the encrypted cloud copy and the copy on this phone. Your chats will be empty.

Your account and contacts are not affected, and you can keep messaging normally afterwards. This cannot be undone.
vaultCustodyConfirmDesc:
Your message history is encrypted with a PIN. Confirm it once so you can restore your messages on a new phone or after reinstalling.

If your vault was set up with just your fingerprint, you may never have been shown a PIN.
vaultCustodyChooseDesc: Pick a PIN you will remember. Every message you already have is kept — it is re-encrypted under the new PIN, nothing is deleted.
vaultCustodyMismatchError: That PIN does not match. If you never chose one, tap "I don't know my PIN".
vaultCustodyAutoUpdateFailed: Could not update the PIN automatically. Please enter your current PIN.
vaultCustodyReencrypting: Re-encrypting {done} of {total}… keep the app open.
vaultSettingsAboutDesc: A private backup of your chat history, locked with your PIN. It brings your messages back when you reinstall the app or switch to a new phone. Only your PIN can open it — nobody else can read what is inside, not even us.
vaultSettingsNeverKept: Never kept here: your call history, contacts, photos shared in chats, or anyone else's private messages.
vaultSettingsBioSubOff: Skip typing your PIN on this device
vaultSettingsBioTurnedOff: Fingerprint unlock turned off. Your PIN still works.
vaultSettingsBioTurnedOn: Fingerprint unlock enabled on this device.
vaultSettingsClearDataDesc: Removes every encrypted message and status from the cloud vault. Your PIN stays the same — new messages will encrypt under it as before. Cannot be undone.
vaultSettingsResetDesc: Removes your PIN, deletes every encrypted entry, and clears the local cache. You will be asked to set a fresh PIN. Cannot be undone.
vaultSettingsChangeDialogDesc: Every encrypted entry will be re-encrypted under the new PIN. Keep the app open until this finishes.
vaultSettingsNewPinMinLength: New PIN must be at least 6 characters.
vaultSettingsBioPinDialogDesc: Your PIN is stored on this device so your fingerprint can unlock the vault. You will still need the PIN itself on a new phone or after reinstalling, so keep it somewhere safe.
premiumCancelAnytime: Cancel anytime from Google Play subscriptions.
premiumProductUnavailable: Product not available. Make sure you have an active internet connection and the app is downloaded from the Play Store.
premiumFeatureMediaDesc: Share photos & videos as status updates
premiumFeatureScreenShareDesc: Share your screen live during chats
premiumFeatureThemesDesc: Patterned backgrounds & gradient bubbles, per chat
premiumFeatureQualityDesc: Sharper photos and longer status videos
premiumFeatureExportDesc: Save a chat as a PDF you can print, or as plain text
premiumFeatureAdFreeDesc: No banner ads anywhere in the app
nearbyHeroDesc: Scanning for devices within 100 meters. Connections are encrypted and peer-to-peer.
nearbyEmptySearchingDesc: Ensure GupShupGo is open on nearby devices with Bluetooth active.
nearbyEmptyOffDesc: Tap the start icon top right to begin scanning.
nearbyPermNeededDesc: Offline chat requires nearby-device and Bluetooth access to discover devices without internet.
nearbyHelpTip: Don't see your friend? Ensure Bluetooth is enabled on both devices.
anonLobbyHangTight: Hang tight — you'll be paired with a random stranger.
anonLobbyPrivacyNote: Your identity stays hidden. Chat as a stranger.
anonLobbyWaitingOthers: Waiting for others to come online…
anonChatFriendsTransition: You are now friends! Opening secure chat…
anonChatFriendReqDesc: Accepting reveals your real profile and starts an encrypted chat.
anonChatReportQuestion: Why are you reporting this user?
anonChatReportSubmitted: Report submitted. Thank you for keeping GupShupGo safe.
anonChatViewOnceVideoDesc: You can only open this video one time. Once you close it, it's gone.
anonChatViewOncePhotoDesc: You can only open this photo one time. Once you close it, it's gone.
unsupportedVersionDesc: This version of GupShupGo is no longer supported. Update to the latest version to keep chatting — your messages and chats are safe and will be there when you come back.
publicProfileNotFoundDesc: This handle doesn't exist or the link is broken.
publicProfileOwnLink: This is your own profile link.

qrScannerNotProfileCode: That's not a GupShupGo profile code.
qrScannerPermissionMsg: Camera access is needed to scan QR codes.
qrScannerBlockedMsg: Camera access is blocked. Enable it in Settings to scan QR codes.
screenShareCantAccept: Couldn't accept the screen share — check your connection and try again.
screenShareSubActive: Your entire screen is visible in high definition.
screenShareMinimizeTip: You can minimize this screen to keep using GupShupGo.
viewOnceUnavailable: This media is no longer available.
viewOnceBlockedFooter: Screenshots are blocked. You can't open this again.
viewOnceUnblockedFooter: You can't open this again. Screenshots can't be blocked on iOS.
